name: CallNYC launch 2026-08-13 A
description: Behavioral evaluation of a faithful, safe, one-page presentation of the 2016 CallNYC civic-data artifact.

criteria.description: The original browse, rank, card, and category drill-down experience remains operable.
Historical evidence remains available without initiating calls to obsolete phone numbers.
A compact frame distinguishes the 2016 artifact from present-day publication status on every existing route.
A descriptive thumbnail opens the preserved Politico article and identifies its headline and date.
A visitor-controlled email asks the Council Data Team and NYC Open Data Team to restore privacy-protected publishing.
Every rendered present-day claim is linked to public evidence, while absence findings remain dated, bounded, and separate from private discovery material.
Core presentation assets load locally without obsolete third-party scripts.
